notes.title: Falling Into Dreams is Going From Paid to Free
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43965883/13495bba14e4d361ee7830230478b3a467867527.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43965883/8f3012efc5760e555a7011777b080a60c53c0601.png[/img][/url]
[b]Falling Into Dreams is transitioning from paid to free[/b] in the coming weeks. I'm making this change to reach a wider audience.

Thank you to everyone who purchased my game! I'm truly grateful.

- KarlFellOffTheCliff, Developer of [i]Falling Into Dreams[/i]
